description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by graph-0026. Expected bytes derived by hand from the rule text at rc.5 (RC5-A); the reference engine does not yet produce them, so this vector is listed in tests/conformance/pending.json until RC5-B. The whole of graph.ttl for a two-node dataset, byte for byte — the file AGSC-04-24 names in the CROSS-IMPLEMENTATION byte-identity set and that no vector pinned before rc.5 (V9A-01, the second blocker for 1.0.0). Derivation, clause by clause of AGSC-05-10: (a) the prefix block is the constant seven lines in the fixed order asc, dcterms, prov, rdfs, schema, skos, xsd, each written '@prefix <pfx>: <IRI> .' with one space after each token — prov:, rdfs: and xsd: are emitted although this dataset uses none of them, which is exactly what makes the block a constant; owl: and rdf: are never declared. (b) one blank line after the block and between subject blocks, one trailing LF, nothing else. (c) subjects by IRI code points, so the Bundle IRI https://a.example/ precedes the item IRI of which it is a prefix; predicates by predicate IRI code points, so rdf:type (http://...) precedes schema:license and schema:usageInfo (https://schema.org/...), which precede asc:specVersion (https://w3id.org/...). (d) first clause on the subject line, every further clause indented by exactly four spaces, clauses separated by ' ;' + LF, block closed by ' .', 'a' written for rdf:type, prefixed names wherever the namespace is in (a) and the local part is a legal PN_LOCAL. (e) every literal here is plain, so none carries ^^xsd:string in Turtle (AGSC-05-31 form c), and the label is language-tagged with the item's lang. The item's schema:license and schema:usageInfo are the two AGSC-05-26 rows added at rc.5 (V9A-02): the licence identifier of bundle.license_prose (CC0-1.0 here, deliberately NOT the Content Use Terms identifier, so the two members cannot be confused) and the constant Content Use Terms identifier of AGSC-06-18, both on the Bundle AND on every item, both plain literals.
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.6 (2026-09-24). This vector's Bundle carries `bundle.license_prose: CC0-1.0` and expects `schema:usageInfo` to name the Content Use Terms. AGSC-06-18 as amended at rc.6 lets the Content Use Terms accompany the prose only where the publisher adopts them; a Bundle whose prose carries another licence places that licence wherever the identifier would stand, `schema:usageInfo` among them. A conforming engine therefore cannot pass this case. Its successor graph-0026 is the same case with the two `schema:usageInfo` literals naming `CC0-1.0`.
